# Temporal_Coding_Signal_Representation

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Encoding information in the precise timing of spikes rather than amplitude, enabling sparse, asynchronous representation of RF and sensor signals. Supports ultra-low-power signal classification and anomaly detection in contested electromagnetic environments.
